eps.c178914441944333: DSE interim disclosure table (Interim Financial Performance section of dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=CITYBANK), unaudited, EPS cumulative Jan-Jun 2026 (Q1 EPS 1.58, Q2-discrete EPS 1.63, H1-cumulative EPS 3.01) — https://www.dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=CITYBANK . NOTE: City Bank's own Q1/Half-Yearly 2026 financial statements PDF could not be located despite extensive attempts (bank's legacy report archive at legacy.citybankplc.com/report/financialstatements is stale, last updated 2021; the current citybankplc.com/reports page is a client-rendered Next.js page with no server-side data or discoverable API; DSE and CSE company pages both defer to the bank's own website for full statements; Wayback Machine has no capture of a 2026 quarterly filing; direct filename guessing on multiple plausible URL patterns all returned 404). DSE's disclosure table does not specify whether its EPS figure is Solo or Consolidated (this dataset's CITYBANK series is otherwise Solo/Standalone throughout) — flagged as an unconfirmed-basis caveat. Only EPS could be sourced this way; paid_up_capital/total_deposit/profit/net_interest_income/npl/roa/roe are NOT populated for 2026 because no balance-sheet or income-statement detail was accessible.
